approval.decision: Runtime admitted as trusted target code by exact source identity

rules: Every file below must match its SHA-256 exactly; any change requires regenerating this manifest in a reviewed commit.
upstream_identical=false marks files S-Go changed; each such file needs a review note in the commit that changed it.
Being listed grants nothing to user code: user-level unsafe, assembly, linkname, and cgo stay denied (SGO-NATIVE-001).
Runtime go statements are exactly the enumerated services (OWN-6); a new one fails the check.

primitives.name: task creation and registration
primitives.sgo: W02: sgoSpawn/sgoAdmit, sgoTaskStart, sgoTaskMain, sgoTaskExit (sgo_scope.go); W05: Start (sgo_ready.go), SpawnWithout (sgo_auth.go)

primitives.name: runtime service goroutines
primitives.sgo: W02: sgoServiceStart/sgoServiceExit classify every newproc creation; enforcement fail-stops unenumerated creation (sgo_service.go)

primitives.name: task ceilings and root grants
primitives.sgo: W05: ceiling fixed by sgoAdmit, sgoRequire, sgoGrantsInit from the linker's -sgogrants (sgo_auth.go)
callers: sgo package (every effect operation, SpawnWithout, root accessors)

primitives.name: native channels and select
primitives.sgo: W07: sgomakechan, sgochansend1, sgochanrecv1/2, sgoclosechan, sgoselectgo/nbsend/nbrecv, sgoblock on the TCB-P12 channel; cancellation unwind sgoCancelUnwind (sgo_native.go, sgo_native_ops.go); Deadlock record (sgo_main.go)

primitives.name: Event and CapacityLimiter
primitives.sgo: W07: sgoEventSet/Wait/IsSet, sgoLimiterAcquire, sgoTokenRelease, token resolution (sgo_sync.go)
